svg.aria-label: Agent Action Stack. One reference path across three public libraries: decide with Constitutional Agent Testbench, act with Consequence Rail, prove a dispute with MandateBound. On policy failure the stack stops. Shown as one action dropping through three stacked frames that light blue, amber and green as it passes.
